name: reparent_node
title: reparent_node
description: Moves a node to a new parent, to a new sibling index, or both. Pass only 'index' to reorder within the current parent — which is how you fix 2D draw order or Control layout order without restructuring anything. The node's world transform is preserved by default: reparenting under a moved or rotated parent would otherwise teleport it, which looks exactly like the tool corrupted your scene. Scripts referencing the node by $Name or by path are reported, because moving a node is the most common way those references silently rot.

node.description: Path of the node to move.

new_parent.description: Path of the new parent. Omit to keep the current parent and only reorder.

index.description: New position among its siblings. Omit to append.

keep_global_transform.description: Preserve world position/rotation/scale across the move. Turn off only when you want the node to inherit the new parent's transform wholesale.

auto_rename.description: Rename on a name collision in the destination rather than failing.

script_references.description: Places in project scripts that mention this node by name or path. Heuristic — evidence, not proof.

errors.cannot_move_root: The scene root has no parent.
errors.cycle: The proposed parent is inside the node being moved.
errors.nothing_to_do: Neither new_parent nor index was given.
errors.name_conflict: The destination already has a child with that name and auto_rename is off.
